name: Block section
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Block section.
Select Add block inside this section. Use the supported block types listed below, then drag them into the desired reading order.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: Show merchant page title and content
settings.how: Turn on “Show merchant page title and content” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Accessibility label
settings.how: Enter the accessibility label. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: HTML tag
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for html tag. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Max width
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust max width. Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions.
